independence.priorWork: Independent roadmap/specification review only; this review inspected implementation for the first time.

scope: Correctness of the fixed actual generated swap/SDK call-preparation rejection helper and connected test controls on the retained 8150-byte historical initialized public state with synthetic private/role inputs. No ledger, Preview, custody authentication or full SP05.2 acceptance.
sourceChecks: Verified all 10 review-candidate file hashes and all 9 input/source plus 4 historical check file hashes/sizes. Rechecked exact frozen bytes after independent tests.

Inspected the actual pinned SDK createUnprovenCallTxFromInitialStates implementation at lines1330-1375: executable runtime runs circuit before creating returned unproven transaction; CompactError is wrapped by ContractRuntimeError and propagated with original assertion message.

Inspected retained generated contract guard order and custody/swap.compact close lines116-121. Program, network and revision guards precede provider capability validation; synthetic role bytes therefore do not establish authentication.

The helper calls the real imported SDK and genuine full-build loader. Three actual cases mock only a pass-through wrapper around the real loader; the SDK/generated execution is not replaced in these cases.

Public input equality compares all native serialized state bytes with the pinned original capture; private equality compares complete V8 serialized synthetic empty input before/after. This checks final serialized input preservation, not intermediate observations or node state.

Connected module mocks intercept the actual imported SDK/loader boundaries for false-success, unrelated-error, matching-message-without-cause, state mutation, private mutation and ZK lookup controls. There are no disconnected proof/balance/submit counters.

Finally cleanup executes on all paths after successful loader acquisition and fails closed on missing/false/throwing cleanup result. Actual loader post-close assertFresh rejection is checked by real-case tests.
Pinned SDK entry bytes are direct pins only; transitive dependency attestation is not claimed. Loader validates full retained artifact/source manifests and does not compile or prove.
Package script adds a separate explicit environment-dependent compiled rejection suite and experimental test module mocks. Required artifacts missing causes failure, not skip/install/rebuild.

Reviewed red, first-green, corrected-green and root-verification logs. Historical failing mutation-test result remains preserved; README correctly distinguishes missing checker red evidence from an already-rejecting generated circuit.
limitations: Historical initialized state is not current live ledger state. No current-state validity, canonical finality, node rejection, included rollback or on-chain nonmutation is established.
No original private store, authenticated real counterparty, wallet, network, compile, proof or service execution was involved. Payer/recipient/fee integration controls remain later obligations.
Cause shape and full serialized equality are checked within this fixed pinned local runtime; this is not a proof about arbitrary hostile SDKs or hidden intermediate effects.

11 current checker tests include only 3 real generated rejection cases; remaining controls deliberately mock the connected interfaces. They must not be counted as additional on-chain or authentic financial cases.
Both independent reviews remain required before publication; this verdict alone does not admit a campaign, reset resources, close SP05.2 or establish PCD.
